# TPC-Havoc Q2_v3

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment FROM part AS p INNER JOIN partsupp AS ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey INNER JOIN supplier AS s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey INNER JOIN nation AS n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey INNER JOIN region AS r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE p.p_size = 15 AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS' AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE' AND ps.ps_supplycost = (SELECT MIN(ps2.ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp AS ps2 INNER JOIN supplier AS s2 ON s2.s_suppkey = ps2.ps_suppkey INNER JOIN nation AS n2 ON s2.s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey INNER JOIN region AS r2 ON n2.n_regionkey = r2.r_regionkey WHERE p.p_partkey = ps2.ps_partkey AND r2.r_name = 'EUROPE') ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_partkey
```
